question: I discard several cards with madness to Anje's Ravager. Do I decide whether to cast them only after I have drawn the three cards?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you choose whether to cast the cards with madness after you have drawn three cards.
expected.answer: If any of the cards you discard have madness, you'll choose whether to cast them after you've drawn three cards.

whyHard: Madness triggers when a card is discarded, so players think the decision comes immediately.
